goal: Add a 'Saltar sincronización' toggle to the QMS-TR run-trigger flow (mirroring CalibrateButton's skip_sync pattern), wire skip_sync into createQmsTrRun, and surface the new run_sync/run_bronze_copy steps (including a skipped/cancelled visual state) in the QMS-TR progress UI and mock-server.
notes: Real backend contract (ms-process-api JAA-1002, commit 5280048): STEPS = [run_sync, run_bronze_copy, silver_builder, kpis_batch, export_zip]. QmsTrRunCreate.skip_sync: bool = True (default TRUE = skip). QmsTrRun.skip_sync: bool. When skip_sync=true, run_sync's step status is 'cancelled' (Databricks SKIPPED condition-task branch), NOT 'completed'; run_bronze_copy always executes.

Ticket text's claim that CalibrateButton defaults skipSync=true is WRONG (actual code: useState(false), backend default false there). QMS-TR's own backend default is TRUE — use that as the source of truth per ac1 ('mismo default que backend'). Documented as-is, not a blocker.
Precedent component: src/modules/calibracion/components/CalibrateButton.tsx (Switch inside AlertDialogDescription, skip_sync passed into the confirm mutate call).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: QmsTrCountryCard's Ejecutar confirm dialog shows a 'Saltar sincronización' Switch, default checked=true
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: render QmsTrCountryCard, open confirm dialog, assert screen.getByRole('switch', {name: /saltar sincronización/i}) is checked by default

acceptance_criteria.criterion: skip_sync is sent in the createQmsTrRun request body, reflecting the toggle state (true by default, false when toggled off)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: mock useCreateQmsTrRun/createQmsTrRun, confirm without toggling -> mutate called with skip_sync:true; toggle off then confirm -> skip_sync:false. Also mock-server test: POST /qms_tr/runs with skip_sync in body is persisted and returned on the run.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: run_sync and run_bronze_copy steps are shown in the run progress (QmsTrProgress + QmsTrDetailModal), and run_sync renders a distinct 'skipped' presentation (not conflated with 'pending' or 'failed') when skip_sync=true
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: QmsTrProgress/QmsTrDetailModal render with a step {name:'run_sync', status:'cancelled'} shows the skipped-specific icon/label (not the default Circle/pending look). mock-server test: create run with skip_sync=true -> run_sync step status is 'cancelled' after the first progression tick, run_bronze_copy step progresses normally.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: vitest suite green, eslint clean, tsc -b clean, Playwright qms-tr specs green (scoped run only)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b; MOCK_SERVER_PORT=8000 npx playwright test qmstr --project=smoke
